info.name: Kuwaiti Experience — App, Website and CMS APIs
info.description: Import the companion Local environment and select it. Set base_url and your phone numbers. Requests are intended to be sent individually: login branches, optional resend, photo selection, logout and deletion require manual choices. See docs/postman/README.md. No real credentials or OTPs are included. Customer token/proof values are captured into the selected environment only after successful responses. SMS request/resend returns 503 until the configured provider adapter is available. Explore v2 browsing, bookmarks and CMS movie/feature/showtime requests are in folders 07–09; see docs/explore-api.md. Home v2 guest/customer reads and CMS management are in folder 09A; see docs/app-api-reference.md section 12. Website footer page and contact endpoints are in folders 01 and 05; see docs/website-api-reference.md. Videos (feed, comments, likes, saves, shares, reports and file streaming) are in folder 11; see docs/videos-api-reference.md. The legacy v1 website and CMS JSON API is in folder 12.

item.name: 02 — Phone login and registration
item.description: Request OTP, enter the received code in otp_code, then verify. On a development or staging server with CUSTOMER_OTP_DEV_RESPONSE=true, enter fixed code 2580; the response never includes the code. The flag also works with NODE_ENV=production and must be disabled before serving real customers. Follow next_action: send Existing customer sign in OR Create account, not both. OTP proofs are one use. Without SMS or the fixed-code option, request/resend returns 503.

request.description: Optional. Wait until resend_available_at. Enter the latest received code before verifying.
Enter the 4-digit SMS code as a string in otp_code. Inspect next_action before choosing the next request.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.environment.set('verification_token', d.verification_token); pm.environment.set('next_action', d.next_action);

request.description: Use only when next_action is sign_in. Captures both customer credentials.
Use only when next_action is create_account. The app handles legal acceptance separately. Email is optional; replace null with an email string to supply it.
Rotates both credentials automatically. Never reuse the previous refresh token.

item.name: 03 — Edit Profile
item.description: Customer bearer tokens are applied automatically. Profile text and photo changes save independently. Nullable Customer fields are always present.

request.description: null clears email. Replace null with an email string, or omit the key to retain it. Omitted names retain their values.

item.name: Upload or replace my profile photo

request.description: In Body → form-data, select a file for the file field. Postman sets the multipart boundary. Saves immediately, independently of text edits.

formdata.description: Select a local JPEG, PNG or WebP image, maximum 5 MB.

request.description: Run after upload. Returns private WebP bytes; Postman Preview displays the image. Returns 404 if no photo exists.
Removes the current photo immediately and returns Customer with profile_photo_id null.

item.name: 04 — Change phone with OTP
item.description: Requires a login verified within the past 10 minutes. Use a different, unused new_phone_e164. Run all steps using the same customer session. Successful save revokes other sessions. SMS must be configured.

request.description: Enter the SMS code in phone_otp_code. The proof is bound to this customer and session.
Consumes the phone proof atomically. You can also include first_name, last_name and email.

item.description: Choose one request manually after testing. Logout revokes this session. Delete permanently removes the customer and owned data, and requires OTP authentication within the past 10 minutes. Do not run this folder as part of a bulk collection run.

item.name: 11 — Videos (feed and interactions)
item.description: Short-video feed for the app. Guest reads work without a token; sending the customer token adds viewer.liked/viewer.saved and comment.mine. Interactions need a customer token from folder 02. Send List video feed first to capture video_id and video_file_path. See docs/videos-api-reference.md.

request.description: Localized reasons for the report sheet. Send the code back when reporting.

Newest first. Optional query: limit (1–30, default 10), category_id, place_id, cursor. The token is optional; remove it to test as a guest. Captures video_id, video_file_path and video_next_cursor from the response.
Uses meta.next_cursor from the previous page. A null cursor means there are no more pages; an edited cursor returns 422 INVALID_CURSOR.

item.name: Video feed starting at a shared video

request.description: Opens a shared link: the video with video_id is returned first, followed by the normal feed. The same video is left out of later pages, so keep sending video_id together with cursor when paging. meta.pinned_video_found tells whether the video was available.
Videos linked to one business (place). category_id works the same way.
One video, for deep links and notifications. 404 NOT_FOUND when unpublished or its business is unpublished.
Newest first. Page with cursor=meta.next_cursor. Hidden comments are never returned.

Public video file from the feed's video_url (/api/v1/video-files/<uuid>.mp4). Sends a Range header so the response is 206 Partial Content; remove the header for the whole file (200). Unpublished files return 404.
Idempotent. Returns { video_id, active, count }.
Idempotent. Returns { video_id, active:false, count }.
Idempotent bookmark.

Idempotent.
No body. Counts one share per call (not deduplicated). Call it after the share sheet opens.
Body 1–500 characters after trimming. Visible immediately. Writes a real record. Captures video_comment_id.
Idempotent. Returns { comment_id, active, count }.
Idempotent.
Only the author can delete; another customer's comment returns 403 FORBIDDEN.
reason must be a code from Report reasons; note is optional (max 500). Reporting the same video twice is accepted and keeps the first report. Writes a real record visible in CMS → Videos → Reports.
